name: print-social-creatives-meet-up-flyer-red-yellow-photo-block
title: 'Creatives Meet up' flyer in red and mustard with a yellow-block portrait and doodle sunburst corners
whatItIs: A red A5 flyer with a mustard-yellow photo block of two posed models in pink and denim, a diamond logo, social icons, two overlapping colour-tag headlines ('Creatives' orange, 'Meet up' tan), a subtitle 'With artist and designer professional', a wavy line motif, and hand-drawn sunburst doodles in two corners.
whatItMeans: Warm and social; overlapping colour tags and sunburst doodles make a professional meetup feel relaxed and inviting.
techniques: Frame a photo in a solid contrasting colour block.
Overlap two tag-style headline words at a slight offset.
Add hand-drawn sunburst doodles as informal corner accents.

vocabulary.definition: A short word set on its own solid colour background like a label.
A hand-drawn radiating line cluster used for emphasis.
